question: Can a bounded simulation-only agent recover and retain plans when hidden prerequisites change and the explicit context label is absent?

world.opaque_role_tokens: seed-stable; source identity remains a strong engineered prior
world.notes: A/B have overlapping prerequisites and a common goal; no hidden graph phase to controller

agents: online plan repair with bounded blocked-at-progress cache, successful-plan library and probe-first recovery
latest successful plan with no within-episode recovery
no persistent plan, identical fallback exploration
metrics: success per phase and per seed
restrictions: No hidden graph, phase or source scenario labels in controller input or stored actions
No real tools, files, network or OS actions exposed
Plan archive relies on same opaque role IDs across episodes and may fail new role vocabularies
No tuning evaluation after looking at development cohort; preserve negative findings
Held-out seed list frozen before running; not independently blind
D1/D3/D4 remain open; V2A before overlapping V2B
